payload.name: draft_supplier_request

args.subject: Open lines HPO-26-00404/10 and HPO-26-00652/10, Gearbox planetary HR-12210: firm dates and terms
args.body:
Dear Katrin Vogel,

We have two open lines with you for Gearbox, planetary (HR-12210). One of them was already past due on 25 September (marked below).

HPO-26-00404/10 · Gearbox, planetary (HR-12210) · 199 EA · promised 24 September (past due)
HPO-26-00652/10 · Gearbox, planetary (HR-12210) · 139 EA · promised 20 November

1. Please give us a firm ship date for each line, and tell us whether the 199 EA on HPO-26-00404/10 can ship as soon as possible.
2. Please confirm both lines will ship on our existing payment terms, with no prepayment. We understand your company is in an insolvency procedure; please also tell us whether the court-appointed monitor has confirmed that open orders will be fulfilled.
3. We would like a bridge quantity of HR-12210 on normal payment terms, without prepayment. Please tell us what quantity you can supply on those terms and the earliest delivery date.
4. For quote AN-2026-1187, Gearbox, planetary (HR-12210): please tell us whether the quoted prices hold for a bridge order placed on those terms before the quote lapses on 31 October.

Please reply by 31 October, and sooner if you can.

Best regards,
Dana Reyes
